newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Newell cut to buy on price.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Newell cut to buy on price.

text.p: -- McDonald & Co said Wednesday it downgraded Newell Co to buy from aggressive buy based on price.
-- Analyst Justin Maurer said in a report he remains psoitive about solid earnings growth prospects for 1997 but shares have moved closer to his $37 price target.
-- The stock was up 3/8 to 32-7/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.

-- Newell reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.51 a share versus year-ago $0.42 and Maurer said it posted strong revenue growth across most business units. He said he retained his $1.85 1997 earnings estimate versus $1.62 for 1996.
